'''Sanitation droids''' were [[Droid/Legends|automatons]] used to collect garbage and waste. In [[4015 BBY]], sanitation droids were among those who rose up in [[Great Droid Revolution|revolt]] against their [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] masters, under the banner of the [[HK-series assassin droid]] [[HK-01]].
